rules.title: Cambridge policy order initiating a ban on algorithmic rent-pricing software
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order directing the city manager to draft policy options or ordinance language that would ban residential property management companies from contracting with companies that use algorithmic or AI-driven models to recommend rents. No ordinance has been adopted yet.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential property management companies in Cambridge that contract with algorithmic or AI rent-recommendation services. Final scope not yet drafted.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Ordinance not yet drafted; scope (e.g., large property managers only) undetermined

rules.citation: Cambridge City Council policy order (sponsor Councillor Sobrinho-Wheeler); no ordinance number given
rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
rules.conflict_note: Policy order only, not an enacted ordinance; the city manager is to return with policy options or ordinance language later in the term. The article date is not stated, and no ordinance citation is provided.

rules.title: Massachusetts bills to ban algorithmic rent-setting
rules.requirement: Bills that would ban the use of algorithmic rent-pricing software in the rental market are pending in the Massachusetts House and Senate.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental market in Massachusetts; specific scope not described.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Bill text and scope not described
